import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Rib {
        long b, u, c, f;
        int back;
        Rib(long b, long u, long c, long f, int back) {
            this.b = b;
            this.u = u;
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
            this.back = back;
        }
    }

    static void addRib(List<List<Rib>> g, long a, long b, long u, long c) {
        g.get((int)a).add(new Rib(b, u, c, 0, g.get((int)b).size())));
        g.get((int)b).add(new Rib(a, 0, -c, 0, g.get((int)a).size() - 1));
    }

    static class K {
        static long n, m, k, c, d;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int MAXN = 100005;
        long INF = 1000L * 1000L * 1000L;

        // Read input parameters
        K.n = sc.nextLong();
        K.m = sc.nextLong();
        K.k = sc.nextLong();
        K.c = sc.nextLong();
        K.d = sc.nextLong();

        int n = (int)(50 * 99 + 1);
        int m = (int)K.m;
        long k = K.k;
        List<List<Rib>> g = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            g.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int s = 0;
        int t = 1;

        long tim = 99;

        long[] lr = new long[55];
        for (int i = 1; i <= K.k; i++) {
            lr[i] = sc.nextLong();
            addRib(g, 0, lr[i], 1, 0);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < tim - 1; j++) {
            for (int i = 2; i <= K.n; i++) {
                addRib(g, j * 50 + i, (j + 1) * 50 + i, 50, K.c);
            }
        }

        for (int j = 1; j < tim; j++) {
            addRib(g, j * 50 + 1, 1, 50, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < K.m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            // Store edges for later processing
            // Using 1-based indexing as in original code
            // For adjacency, we will process later
            // But since we need to add edges between nodes, we can process directly
            // Store in a list for processing
            // For simplicity, store in a list of edges
            // But in Java, better to process immediately

            // But to keep code similar, process after reading all edges

            // But to keep code simple, process immediately
            // So, store edges in a list

            // But for now, just store in a list
            // So, define a list outside
            // But in Java, better to process after reading all edges
            // So, define a list of edges
            // Let's do that
        }

        // To process edges, we need to store them first
        // So, define a list
        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        // Re-read edges
        sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < K.m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            edges.add(new int[]{x, y});
        }

        // Add edges
        for (int[] e : edges) {
            int x = e[0];
            int y = e[1];
            for (int j = 0; j < tim - 1; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < 50; l++) {
                    addRib(g, j * 50 + x, (j + 1) * 50 + y, 1, (K.c) + (K.d) * ((l + 1) * (l + 1) - l * l));
                    addRib(g, j * 50 + y, (j + 1) * 50 + x, 1, (K.c) + (K.d) * ((l + 1) * (l + 1) - l * l));
                }
            }
        }

        // Add source edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= K.k; i++) {
            addRib(g, 0, lr[i], 1, 0);
        }

        long flow = 0;
        long cost = 0;

        while (flow < k) {
            int nNodes = g.size();
            int[] id = new int[nNodes];
            long[] d = new long[nNodes];
            Arrays.fill(d, INF);
            int[] q = new int[nNodes];
            int[] p = new int[nNodes];
            int[] p_rib = new int[nNodes];

            int qh = 0, qt = 0;
            q[qt++] = s;
            d[s] = 0;

            while (qh != qt) {
                int v = q[qh++];
                if (qh == nNodes) qh = 0;
                id[v] = 2;
                for (int i = 0; i < g.get(v).size(); i++) {
                    Rib r = g.get(v).get(i);
                    if (r.f < r.u && d[v] + r.c < d[(int)r.b]) {
                        d[(int)r.b] = d[v] + r.c;
                        if (id[(int)r.b] == 0) {
                            q[qt++] = (int)r.b;
                            if (qt == nNodes) qt = 0;
                        } else if (id[(int)r.b] == 2) {
                            if (--qh == -1) qh = nNodes - 1;
                            q[qh] = (int)r.b;

                        id[(int)r.b] = 1;
                        p[(int)r.b] = v;
                        p_rib[(int)r.b] = i;

            }

            if (d[t] == INF) break;

            long addFlow = k - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = p[v]) {
                int pv = p[v];
                int pr = p_rib[v];
                addFlow = Math.min(addFlow, g.get(pv).get(pr).u - g.get(pv).get(pr).f);
            }

            for (int v = t; v != s; v = p[v]) {
                int pv = p[v];
                int pr = p_rib[v];
                int rIdx = g.get(pv).get(pr).back;
                g.get(pv).get(pr).f += addFlow;
                g.get(v).get(rIdx).f -= addFlow;
                cost += g.get(pv).get(pr).c * addFlow;
            }
            flow += addFlow;
        }

        System.out.println(cost);
    }
